class.name: CASBackend
class.brief_description: A shared store for the editor's import cache.
class.description: The editor keeps the results of imports in a content-addressed cache, so that importing a file with the same contents and settings again (for example after switching branches) doesn't run the importer. Backends extend this cache to other machines: they are queried when a result isn't available locally, and given the results of imports made locally. Manifests describe the result of an import and are identified by the hash of everything the import depends on. Objects (imported files) are stored as lists of chunks, so that near-identical files only transfer the chunks that differ. Hashes are BLAKE3 hashes, as lowercase hexadecimal strings. Everything received from a backend is verified against its hash. Backends are only used by the editor. They must be thread-safe, as imports run on multiple threads.

method.name: _get_chunk
method.description: Returns the chunk with the hash [param hash], or an empty array if it isn't available.

method.name: _get_manifest
method.description: Returns the manifest of the import key [param key], or an empty array if it isn't available.

method.name: _get_object_chunks
method.description: Returns the hashes of the chunks of the object with the hash [param hash], in order, or an empty array if it isn't available.

method.name: _has_chunks
method.description: Returns one byte for each hash in [param hashes], which is not [code]0[/code] if the chunk is available.

method.name: _is_writable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if import results can be added to the backend.

method.name: _put_chunk
method.description: Stores the chunk [param data] with the hash [param hash].

method.name: _put_manifest
method.description: Stores the manifest [param data] of the import key [param key]. It is called after storing all of its objects.

method.name: _put_object_chunks
method.description: Stores the list of chunks [param chunks] of the object with the hash [param hash]. It is called after storing all of its chunks.

method.name: add_import_cache_backend
method.description: Adds [param backend] to the editor's import cache. Backends are queried in the order they were added.

method.name: remove_import_cache_backend
method.description: Removes a backend added with [method add_import_cache_backend].
